import pytest

from inventory import Inventory


def test_req_remove_subtracts():
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("a", 5)
    inv.remove("a", 2)
    assert inv.count("a") == 3


def test_req_insufficient_raises_and_keeps_stock():
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("a", 1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="insufficient stock"):
        inv.remove("a", 2)
    assert inv.count("a") == 1


def test_req_unknown_item_raises():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="insufficient stock"):
        Inventory().remove("nope", 1)


def test_reg_add_unchanged():
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("a", 0)
    assert inv.items == {"a": 0}
